As a reachtruck driver, you will ensure the warehouse at the logistics site in Desteldonk keeps running smoothly. You will ensure a fluent and correct flow of goods. You combine your reach truck experience with an active work attitude and contribute to a streamlined process within an international network.

Are you looking for a new long-term challenge? Apply today via talentcenter40@randstad.be or 09 218 79 35!

VG 458/BUOSAP

Who are we looking for for this vacancy?

• You hold a valid reachtruck certificate or have gained the necessary experience as a reachtruck driver.
• You are flexible and willing to work day hours from 8:00 AM - 4:36 PM, 9:00 AM - 5:36 PM, or 10:00 AM - 6:36 PM.

In the role of reachtruck driver, you will carry out the following tasks:

• Safely and efficiently loading and unloading goods.
• Accurately storing and putting away incoming shipments in the correct rack locations with a reachtruck.
• Performing quality control checks upon receipt of goods.
• Flexibly assisting as an order picker in the warehouse when there is less reach truck work.

Pattyn Group (€158 million turnover), headquartered in Bruges, is a pioneer in automated packaging solutions. We specialize in bulk packaging for a wide range of industries, including food, pharmaceuticals, and industrial goods. We design and build innovative, high-quality packaging machinery that seamlessly integrates into production lines, helping customers improve efficiency, reduce waste, and enhance product safety throughout the packaging process.
 

We operate in five countries, with production sites in Bruges (Pattyn Belgium & Pattyn Metal Construction), Deerlijk (Pattyn Bulk Packaging), France (Pattyn France) and Spain (GMP) as well as sales and service centers in Kuala Lumpur (Pattyn Asia) and North America (Pattyn North America). With over 250 employees in Belgium and more than 600 colleagues worldwide, we continue to grow and strengthen our position as a global partner in packaging technology.
 

As a proud member of the 
Duravant family, a global leader in engineered equipment and automation solutions, Pattyn benefits from an extensive international network, strategic investments, and access to cutting-edge technologies. This partnership enables us to further expand our expertise, accelerate innovation, and deliver groundbreaking packaging solutions to customers around the world. Driven by a passionate team of professionals, we continuously push the boundaries of packaging automation while fostering an entrepreneurial, collaborative, and rewarding environment where talented people can grow and make an impact.
 

Your challenge
 

The Group Accounting & Internal Controls Manager is responsible for ensuring consistent, accurate and compliant accounting practices across all Pattyn Group entities. 
 

The role drives the standardization of accounting policies, safeguards the integrity of financial reporting and internal controls, and acts as the primary point of contact for external auditors across the Group. 
 

In addition, the position plays a key role in improving the efficiency and reliability of financial closing processes, strengthening financial governance and supporting local finance teams in applying Group standards and best practices.
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

• Group Accounting Governance & Compliance 

• External Audit Management 

• Internal Controls & SOX Compliance 

• Balance Sheet Integrity & Reconciliations 

• Financial Closing & Process Improvement 

• Stakeholder Management & Capability Building  

 

 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance or related field; professional accounting qualification (CPA, ACCA or equivalent) preferred. 

• Minimum 7 years of relevant experience, preferably including Big 4 audit and/or Group Accounting in a multinational environment. 

• Strong knowledge of IFRS and/or US GAAP, consolidation, SOX compliance and internal control frameworks. 

• Proven experience in external audit management and international accounting practices. 

• Strong analytical skills, technical rigor and attention to detail, with a high standard for accuracy and compliance. 

• Process-driven and improvement-oriented, with the ability to identify inefficiencies and implement practical solutions. 

• Strong ownership, organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. 

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority and coach local finance teams. 

• Strong ERP knowledge, advanced Excel skills and affinity with digitalization and automation. 

• Fluent English; French is a strong asset.

Do you have kitchen experience and enjoy working with fresh products? Are you hands-on, reliable, and looking for a stable job with opportunities to grow? Then we would love to meet you!
 

Your responsibilities
 

As a Production Kitchen Worker, you will be part of a motivated team responsible for preparing and processing fresh vegetables on a daily basis.
 

Your tasks include:
 

 
• Cleaning and washing vegetables.
 
• Cutting and preparing vegetables both manually and with machines.
 
• Operating vegetable cutting equipment safely and efficiently.
 
• Maintaining a clean and hygienic work environment.
 
• Following quality and food safety standards. 

 
• Previous experience in a professional kitchen is required.
 
• You are comfortable with physical work and enjoy staying active.
 
• You work accurately and pay attention to hygiene.
 
• You are available to work on Mondays and Saturdays.
 
• You can start work between 6:00 AM and 7:00 AM.
 
• You speak English or Dutch.
 
• Experience working in Belgium is not required.

jobs.description:
As part of the finance team, you will take ownership of several legal entities across Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg, with the opportunity to gradually expand your responsibilities and make a visible impact on the organization's future.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage the full accounting cycle for several entities across Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg.
• Handle daily accounting operations, including purchase invoices, bank transactions, payments, reconciliations, and journal entries.
• Prepare monthly and year-end closings, provisions, accruals, and supporting financial analyses.
• Ensure timely VAT, Intrastat, and statutory reporting obligations are met.
• Prepare annual accounts and support audit activities in collaboration with the Chief Accountant.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of accounting processes and support ad hoc finance projects.

• Holds a degree in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent professional experience.
• Speaks fluent French and Dutch ; English is a great asset.
• Has solid end-to-end accounting experience and is comfortable managing entities autonomously.
• Has a strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting, VAT, and statutory obligations.
• Is structured, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities effectively.
• Demonstrates ambition, curiosity, and a willingness to take on increasing responsibilities over time.
• Thrives in a pragmatic, hands-on, and collaborative environment where initiative is valued.

For our client, we are looking for a motivated INDUSTRIAL CLEANER.
 

 
• Assisting with emptying the tunnels (partially mechanical/partially manual)
 
• Cleaning large tunnels using a high-pressure cleaner
 
• Assisting with filling the tunnels
 
• Thinking along when adding quantities of spawn
 
• Cleaning transport belts at height (no fear of heights!) 

What do we expect from you as an industrial cleaner?
 

 
• You have some initial experience as an industrial cleaner
 
• You are in good physical health and not afraid to work in a dirty environment
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system (5-13 & 13-21)
 
• You actively contribute to the cleaning process
 
• You are a team player but can also work independently
 
• You speak Dutch, French or English

What are your responsibilities as a forklift driver?
 

 
• Receiving and correctly storing incoming goods in the warehouse
 
• Loading and unloading trucks
 
• Scanning products in and out using a scanning system
 
• Operating a forklift (approximately 80% of the time) and an electric pallet truck (approximately 20%)
 
• Maintaining a clean, safe, and organized workplace
 
• Working in a chilled environment with a closed and heated forklift 

 
• You hold a valid forklift certificate
 
• You have experience stacking and working at heights of up to 10 meters
 
• You speak Dutch, French, or English

• Safety is always your top priority
 
• You enjoy working independently but also function well within a team

Our client, based in Mechelen, is an international leader in medical imaging. You will join a modern and people-oriented working environment where quality, collaboration, and personal development are at the heart of everything they do.

Jobomschrijving

Would you like to work for an international company where technology and healthcare come together?

As a Technical Support Officer, you will become part of a close-knit team, supporting customers with high-quality software solutions for the medical sector. You'll benefit from a comprehensive training programme and plenty of opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.

Your responsibilities as a Technical Support Officer:

As a Technical Support Officer, you are the first point of contact for customers who need technical assistance. You primarily support French-speaking customers, while also communicating regularly in English with colleagues and customers from other countries.

• Provide technical support to customers regarding software, hardware, and connectivity issues.
• Assist customers via phone, email, and remote support, primarily in French.
• Analyse technical issues and work together with customers to find the most suitable solution.
• Guide customers through software installations, updates, and configurations.
• Accurately register and follow up on support requests in the CRM system.
• Escalate more complex issues to specialised colleagues when necessary.
• Work closely with colleagues and other internal departments to resolve complex technical queries.

Who are we looking for?

• You have initial experience in Technical Support, Customer Support, or an IT Help Desk role.
• You have a strong interest in software, IT, and technology.
• You are fluent in both French and English, both spoken and written, as you will use these languages daily when communicating with customers and colleagues.
• You are solution-oriented and remain organised when dealing with multiple requests at the same time.
• You are able to prioritise effectively and manage your workload efficiently.
• A secondary education diploma (A2 level) is sufficient. Above all, we value your motivation, eagerness to learn, and passion for technology.

An organisation based in Zaventem operating within the property sector.

Jobomschrijving

As a Sales Support Specialist, you play a central role in ensuring a smooth and professional experience for our business partners and internal stakeholders.You act as a key coordination point between Sales, Finance, Operations, and our external partners, supporting the full lifecycle of sales-related requests.This role goes beyond pure administration. You work within structured procedures, but you also think proactively, communicate clearly, and help ensure that everything runs efficiently in a service-driven environment.What you will do

• Act as the main contact person for business partners and internal teams within the sales support scope
• Provide administrative and operational support to the sales team
• Register, process, and follow up on requests and applications through the full workflow, including validation with financial partners
• Manage customer and partner communication via email and web portal, ensuring speed, clarity, and professionalism
• Coordinate with internal departments such as Sales, Order Processing, Finance, and Operations
• Prepare and manage documents using structured templates and standardized procedures
• Monitor incoming and outgoing requests, documentation, and order statuses, and proactively resolve issues
• Ensure strict compliance with internal procedures and company policies, working in a detailed and precise manner
• Support the onboarding of new business partners, guiding them through tools, processes, and ways of working
• Maintain an overview of contracts, ongoing files, and partnership-related communication
• Contribute to continuous process improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and communication

What you bring to the table

• At least 2 years of experience in a sales support, administrative, or coordination role
• Experience in service-oriented environments such as banking, insurance, leasing, or similar sectors is a strong asset
• A structured and process-oriented mindset, with strong attention to detail
• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
• Strong communication skills, with a customer- and partner-oriented approach
• Ability to work independently, while also thriving in a close-knit team where collaboration is key
• Languages: Very good knowledge of Dutch or French, with professional working knowledge of the other language
• English is a plus
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools and web-based applications
• No advanced financial calculations required; a basic understanding of financial concepts is sufficient

An international company based in Zaventem is looking for a (Junior) Accountant to join its Corporate Finance & Accounting team. In this role, you will support a wide range of accounting activities, contribute to monthly closing and reporting processes, and assist with audits. You will work closely with colleagues across different departments in an international environment.

Your responsibilities:

• You support internal departments with accounting-related questions, SAP bookings and invoice processing.
• You monitor invoice workflows in DMS and follow up on outstanding items.
• You process general expense invoices, bank bookings and employee expense claims in SAP.
• You support monthly closing, reporting, reconciliations and account checks.
• You follow up on open items, overdue payments and account discrepancies.
• You prepare audit documentation and support J-SOX requirements, fixed asset checks and stock counts.
• You update accounting procedures and contribute to process improvements.
• You provide back-up support for payments, banking, reporting and other accounting tasks.

Your profile:

• You have a bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field.
• You are a motivated recent graduate or a junior accountant with some initial work experience.
• You have a good understanding of accounting principles and feel comfortable working with figures.
• You are confident using SAP and MS Office.
• You work accurately and in a structured way and have a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
• You communicate effectively with different stakeholders and are a strong team player.
• You are fluent in English and have a good knowledge of French and Dutch.

Part electrical, part mechanical, and no two days are the same. Callewaert Industries Technical Support is looking for an electromechanical technician to join a 2-shift team at one of our clients in the Roeselare area. You'll be employed by Callewaert Industries and work as part of the client's maintenance team.
 

The job
 

•
 You track down and fix breakdowns, roughly half electrical, half mechanical.
 

•
 You keep production lines and machinery up and running.
 

•
 Mechanical repairs and part replacements are yours to handle, and you troubleshoot electrical faults on your own.
 

•
 You log every job accurately and keep the maintenance team in the loop.

•
 You're as comfortable with a multimeter as with a spanner.
 

•
 You've worked as an electromechanic or maintenance technician in a production environment.
 

•
 You work independently and never cut corners on safety.
 

•
 You speak Dutch or English.

For a leading player in the Belgian logistics sector, we are looking for a CE Driver for the Ghent site.

For the Ghent site, we are looking for a CE Driver who enjoys working with a dedicated tractor unit and a flexible day schedule.

Your responsibilities

• Prepare each trip carefully and perform the necessary vehicle checks

• Verify transport documents and ensure load safety

• Couple and uncouple trailers

• Occasionally assist with loading and unloading goods

• Report any issues or delays to the planning team in a timely manner

• Carry out safe and efficient deliveries to customers and the airport

• Contribute to a professional and reliable service

Who are you?

• You hold a valid CE driving licence

• You have previous experience as a CE Driver

• You possess a valid digital driver card, ADR certificate, Code 95, and medical certificate

• You are willing to work a flexible schedule, starting from 5:00 AM

• You are prepared to spend 1 to 2 nights per week in the truck when required

• You are comfortable using GPS systems and other driving support tools

• You communicate effectively in Dutch, French or English

• You are customer-oriented, reliable, and responsible

• Safety and quality are always your top priorities

• You have a genuine passion for transport and logistics

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
 

Within the EHS team, the Safety Advisor is part of the Internal Service for Prevention and Protection at Work and reports directly to the EHS Manager. The Safety Advisor works with fellow safety advisors to help create a safe and healthy ELC for teammates and external partners. This role collaborates closely with departments across the business, especially the Distribution Directors of the Distribution Centers (DCs) in Ham or Laakdal. The Safety Advisor also partners with DC teams and CPBW members to support continuous improvement in safety and health.
 

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON
 

You will help protect the well-being of teammates and external partners by advising the employer and managers on safety and health. You will assess workstations and distribution activities, map risks, investigate hazards where needed, and translate findings into practical advice.
 

You will support new installations and processes by providing managers with commissioning reports that are clear, timely, and actionable.
 

You will strengthen prevention by supporting incident and accident investigations, identifying root causes, and proposing measures that help prevent recurrence.
 

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 

Within the Nike ELC, Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) is looking for a Safety Advisor. This role is part of the Internal Service for Prevention and Protection at Work and supports the employer in creating safe, healthy working conditions for teammates and external partners, in line with Belgian Welfare Legislation.
 

 
 

Your Baseline to Play at Pro Level:
 
 

•  

Safety Expertise. Level 1 certification preferred, or at least three years of hands-on experience at Level 2.
  

•  

Belgian Welfare Legislation Knowledge. Knowledge of, or experience with, Belgian welfare and workplace safety legislation.
  

•  

Collaboration Skills. Ability to work effectively with operational teams, managers, CPBW members, and stakeholders across the business.
  

•  

Independent Working Style. Able to work independently, manage priorities, and connect the right partners when follow-up is needed.
  

•  

Language Proficiency. Fluent in Dutch and English, with clear written and verbal communication skills.
   

 
 

As a plus:
 

Any one of the following can strengthen the profile:
 
 

•  

Machine Safety: Strong knowledge of machine safety principles and how to apply them in an operational environment.
  

•  

Technical Background. A technical secondary school degree, plus ideally experience in a fast-paced logistics environment.
  

•  

Ergonomic Knowledge. Ability to assess ergonomic risks and translate findings into clear, practical improvements.
   

 
 

Other Skills That Step Up Your Performance:
 
 

•  

Facilitation and Reporting Skills. Can facilitate discussions with diverse stakeholders and translate complex information into clear, structured reports.
  

•  

Work Schedule Flexibility. Available to occasionally support outside standard office hours when operational needs require it.
